title: Recruitment Consultant
description: Frontwise is an international company with a unique company culture. We deliver full-cycle recruitment services with a sourcing heartbeat. As a strategic growth partner, we serve multiple international clients from our modern office in the center of Skopje. To find the best candidates for our clients, we have a distinctive tech-savvy way of working. Characteristics of our culture are ‘continuous learning’, having impact and ‘work hard play hard’. We are looking for a proactive, communicative person who is looking for an international, inspiring environment, in which continuous learning is the standard. At Frontwise, people grow as a person as well as a professional. Do you want to accelerate your development? Then you are more than welcome at Frontwise! Why choose us? • Over 11+ years of international recruitment experience • Tech-driven, high-quality sourcing approach • Agile, project-based teams with real ownership • Fast learning curve and visible impact • One of the coolest offices in North Macedonia • Great colleagues What do we offer? • Modern recruitment beyond CV-driven processes • Supportive, ambitious, down-to-earth team culture • Strong onboarding and continuous learning • International clients and complex projects • A balanced hybrid setup, half remote, half office, fully connected What do we expect from you? • Fluent English (spoken and written) • Bachelor’s or master’s degree • 2+ years of relevant experience • A can-do mentality • Curious, proactive, and eager to grow Curious to experience what makes Frontwise different? Apply and find out.
